name: Default
label: Modern
description: ProjectToolkit's default scheduler page: a plain modern style, light or dark with the system setting. A project names its own theme with page.theme in scheduler.json; see README.md (Run the queue).

text.redHealth: main does not build or pass its gate. Dispatching is held until it is green again.

css: body { margin: 0; color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.45 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }
.screen { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 20px; background: var(--panel);
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.screen .t { flex: 1; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.win { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; margin: 0 0 16px;
.bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--bar);
.slots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin: 0 0 16px; }
td, th { text-align: left; padding: 6px 10px; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
th { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.mute { color: var(--muted); } .ok { color: var(--ok); } .warn { color: var(--warn); }
a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; } a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
code { font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; }
button { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent-text); background: var(--accent); border: 0;
button[disabled], button[disabled]:hover { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; filter: none; }
button.bad { background: transparent; color: var(--bad); border: 1px solid var(--bad); font-weight: normal; }
form.q { margin: 2px 0; } form.q input { font: inherit; width: 14em; margin: 0 4px; }
form.send { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; } form.send input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font: inherit; }
.stats { margin: 2px 0 4px; } table.waiting td { vertical-align: top; } table.waiting td .g { margin-bottom: 0; }
dialog.settings { padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--log-bg); color: inherit; min-width: 24em; }
dialog.settings label { display: block; margin: 6px 0; } dialog.settings label.lane { display: inline-block; margin-right: 12px; }
dialog.settings input:not([type]) { font: inherit; width: 30em; max-width: 100%; display: block; }
.g[data-tip]:not([data-tip='']):hover::after { content: attr(data-tip); position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); z-index: 20;
background: var(--text); color: var(--panel); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px;
width: max-content; max-width: 340px; white-space: normal; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .2); }
pre.log { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--log-bg); border: 1px solid var(--line);
border-radius: 6px; overflow: visible; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all;
